The closest proposal is to **equip the agent with a prior over possible environments and update its beliefs using Bayesian updating as observations arrive**. This lets it use accumulated evidence about which environment it inhabits; its internal state can also retain information from earlier percepts rather than relying only on the current percept (http://link.springer.com/10.1007/978-3-319-26485-1_2).

However, the passages do not explicitly present this as a solution to the specific problem of different physical environments looking identical to the agent.
